grounding.observation: The measured native5 descent and original reference remain distinct sources; appearance29 is rejected.
grounding.comparison: No native or audiovisual improvement is claimed for10.

expert_coverage.observation: Plan includes support, contact timing, rider and garment cache dependencies.
expert_coverage.comparison: Numerical speed is not fluidity qualification.

film_alignment.observation: Accepted Pashtun floor is retained; rejected appearance cannot be propagated as approved.
film_alignment.comparison: Narrow motion proof cannot qualify whole supporting cast.

preferences.observation: No routine Director method gate is introduced.
preferences.comparison: Actual exhaustion, not incremental improvement, is the stopping condition.

reference_roles.observation: Original rearing video remains choreography authority, not merely inspirational material.
reference_roles.comparison: Still samples do not establish full-speed resemblance.

method.observation: Chosen native23 parent opens in MF neutral garment studio. nihang_motion.run calls support.capture_stance using the active scene before the later transfer operation selects production scene.
method.comparison: The earlier production-active native5 parent did not expose this assumption. Unit interpolation tests do not cover owning-scene evaluation.

interfaces.observation: nihang_control.selected_state temporarily selects production scene but restores the original neutral scene before patch application. Production rig evaluation is therefore not established for the planned motion call.
interfaces.comparison: A valid object name and preserved transform are not proof of an evaluated pose in the correct scene.

efficient_quality.observation: The dependency defect was caught before native dispatch. Do not spend a render on a known-invalid plan.
efficient_quality.comparison: Retain rejected plan and source rather than silently repin or bypass admission.

authority.observation: Motion10/max10 is the last previously authorized correction. The new shared ten were all consumed by appearance20-29. Replanning must not create an eleventh shared correction or reset either limit.
authority.comparison: No new spending, provider or installation is authorized.

strongest_counterexample: A mathematically improved curve could be baked against unevaluated production actors while the neutral proof scene remains active, producing misleading support and garment results.

issues.reason: Parent scene state is incompatible with the motion handler's implicit active-scene assumption.
issues.counterexample: Native23 neutral studio is restored after selected_state; capture_stance immediately evaluates bpy.context.scene.
issues.repair: Explicitly resolve and validate the unique production owning scene before motion capture, test neutral-active and production-active parents, and repin downstream planning through the controller. Requires renewed correction authority because current10/max10 is exhausted.
